data.name: Stillman
data.long_meaning: The name Stillman originated in the English language and is derived from the Old English words 'stille' meaning 'still' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. This name symbolizes a calm and steady individual, one who is unwavering and resolute in their actions and beliefs. In a Christian context, the name Stillman may also be seen as a reminder of God's unchanging nature and steadfast love.
